minted.name: typescript-logic-fixer
minted.rationale: Both mocka and mockb declare vitest and typescript and need small logic fixes in TypeScript source files, so one implementer spanning the project can author both fixes without minting near-duplicate roles per codeline.

minted.name: fares-investigator
minted.rationale: mocka's fare boundary bug sits in a single module whose comparison operator and callers must be read in-repo before any fix is written, so this codeline needs its own reader.

minted.name: schedule-investigator
minted.rationale: mockb's departure-board bug hinges on a loop bound in formatStops whose callers and display paths must be read in-repo before any fix is written, so this codeline needs its own reader.
